integrity: Proof with finite exhaustive covariance tests at m=4 and m=5 and direct multiplication-matrix spectral tests. Independence of audits is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only canonical triple-block idempotents in independently and fairly signed real Grassmannian incidence algebras. It determines exact covariance and empirical weak convergence, not the entire profile law or fluctuations of the profile vector. Earlier deterministic spectral identification belongs to Fox–Tkachev; full prior-art completeness and independent audit are not claimed.
title: Exact covariance and almost-sure Gaussian Peirce profiles of randomly decorated Grassmannian incidence algebras
